cases.citation: plutiedev vdp-commands (VRAM write 0x40000000 and read 0x00000000 command words); Sega Genesis Software Manual, VDP data-port read
plutiedev vdp-commands (CRAM write 0xC0000000, read 0x00000020); Sega Genesis Software Manual, CRAM word format 0000 BBB0 GGG0 RRR0 (values use only defined bits)
plutiedev vdp-commands (VSRAM write 0x40000010, read 0x00000010); Sega Genesis Software Manual, 11-bit vertical scroll entries
plutiedev vdp-registers, register 15 auto-increment: word writes at 0x2000 and 0x2004 read back in order with increment 4
plutiedev vdp-setup and vdp-commands: data port 0xC00000/0xC00002 and control port 0xC00004/0xC00006 behave identically
Sega Genesis Software Manual, VDP status register: FIFO empty 0x200, DMA busy 0x02, PAL 0x01 (NTSC reads 0); preceding data read has drained the FIFO

Genesis Plus GX vdp_ctrl.c status composition (VBLANK also reads set while the display is disabled); the Sega manual defines the bit only for vertical blanking, so this is reference-derived, not documented evidence
plutiedev vdp-commands: control port 0xC00006 mirrors 0xC00004; read returns the status register (same bit sources as status-fifo-empty-dma-pal)
Status bits 15-10, VINT, SOVR, SCOL and HBLANK depend on undocumented bus residue or Genewhip's own instruction timing; no independent expected value exists
Genesis Plus GX vdp_ctrl.c clears the pending command flag on a status read; plutiedev vdp-commands is silent on this, so the case is reference-derived, not documented evidence
HV counter V and H bytes at the read tick depend on Genewhip's instruction timing; no independent expected value exists
Sega documentation lists 40 VSRAM entries; the value read past them is undocumented in the cited pages
ports.s control flow: the marker store is the last instruction before the idle loop, so it is reached only if every earlier port access completed without an unsupported stop
